question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
SELECT d.year, d.full_name as driver_name, c.constructor_name
FROM (
    SELECT r.year, ds.driver_id, d.full_name
    FROM driver_standings_ext ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN drivers_ext d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
    GROUP BY r.year, ds.driver_id, d.full_name
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(ds.points) DESC) = 1
) d
JOIN (
    SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id, c.name
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY SUM(cs.points) DESC) = 1
) c ON d.year = c.year
ORDER BY d.year
